additionalDocuments.label: Ellington Views I original amenities plans (Mitchell’s mirror)

review.gallery: Eight developer renders and one dated construction photograph. The listing and gallery lead show the named Views I tower entrances. The original renders include the beach terrace and three example interiors. The October photograph is progress evidence, with no completion claim.
review.location: The developer’s marked regional map and 14 time estimates match the project brochure. Haus & Estates links to an approximate Google Maps development pin. Wynn’s 5 November 2026 Q3 results give an expected September 2027 opening.
review.floorPlans: Twenty-five original drawings: 11 residences, 10 floor plates, 4 amenity plans. Verified titles, groupings and areas visually. The two-bedroom study Type 2 printed total differs from its components by 0.21 sq ft. Type 3 two-bedroom and Type 3 one-bedroom show 0.01 sq ft differences. The drawings are from the Views I set only.

unavailable: Surveyed entrance and contracted unit areas. No developer photograph of a completed Views I apartment was verified.
